card-summary.name: Card Summary
card-summary.purpose: Summarize one payment card, balance, limit, masked number, and status without owning wallet flows, card detail actions, or account orchestration.

anatomy.rule: One card-level container for a single payment instrument.
Card name, driver, or vehicle context.
Displays safe card identifier without sensitive data.
Shows active, frozen, warning, or disabled state.
Shows one or two summary values only.

variants.description: Physical card summary with masked PAN.
Virtual card summary with digital status.

card-summary.statePrecedence: disabled > frozen > warning > active > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic surface, action, status, and border color.
Energy.behavior: Operational status remains legible without raw colors.

Voice.decision: Use concise labels, status, and metadata.
Voice.behavior: Users can scan the item without entering a pattern.

Frame.decision: Use stable mobile-first geometry and target size.

Depth.decision: Use elevation only to separate the component from its surface.
Depth.behavior: Depth clarifies hierarchy without creating workspace behavior.
Depth.rejectIf: Depth implies a modal or process.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System transitions for hover, focus, loading, and pressed states.
Momentum.behavior: State changes feel responsive and respect reduced motion.

State.decision: Use explicit state precedence from the contract.
State.example: disabled > frozen > warning > active > focus > hover > default

Tone.decision: Use warning or danger only with visible reason.
Tone.behavior: Risk is communicated through copy and state.

Growth.decision: Escalate grouping, actions, detail, or orchestration to patterns.

Symbol.decision: Use symbols as support for visible labels or accessible names.
Symbol.behavior: Icons aid recognition without replacing meaning.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing and optical alignment.
Iconography.behavior: Symbols align with text and target size.

Accessibility.decision: Expose label, status, focus, keyboard behavior, and non-color state.
Accessibility.behavior: Assistive technology can operate or understand the component.

props.name: metrics
props.notes: One or two local card metrics.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Visual emphasis for the single-card summary.

props.name: state
props.type: default | hover | focus | active | warning | frozen | disabled

props.name: icon
props.notes: Supporting system icon for the card identity.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Allow the summary to fill a sheet/header surface.

do: Use for one payment card summary.
dont: Do not include card lifecycle actions inside the component.
Do not expose full PAN or sensitive account data.
Do not use it as a wallet dashboard.
info: Check status contrast and non-color cues.

agentInstructions: Use Card Summary for wallet header, driver card preview, admin card row expansion, or mobile card sheet header.
Keep identifiers masked and metrics limited to one or two values.
Use frozen or warning state only with visible copy.
rejectIf: Card Summary owns freeze, replace, dispute, or wallet flows.
Multiple cards are managed inside one component.
